name: robots/avidbots__flatland
title: Flatland 2-D simulator
intro: Flatland 2-D simulator, adapted from avidbots/flatland. It reads `read_sim_clock`; runs `pause` and `resume`. `pause`: pause the simulated world with the acknowledged pause service. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/avidbots__flatland --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/avidbots__flatland --backend fake --mcp
